The dspk.synapse modules, one page each: what each function takes and returns.

| Module | What it is for |
|---|---|
| [`dspk.synapse.io`](/dsp-kitchen/plugins/synapse/reference/python/io/) | Probes (site geometry. |
| [`dspk.synapse.detection`](/dsp-kitchen/plugins/synapse/reference/python/detection/) | Spike detection. |
| [`dspk.synapse.extraction`](/dsp-kitchen/plugins/synapse/reference/python/extraction/) | Snippets. |
| [`dspk.synapse.features`](/dsp-kitchen/plugins/synapse/reference/python/features/) | Waveform features. |
| [`dspk.synapse.clustering`](/dsp-kitchen/plugins/synapse/reference/python/clustering/) | Clustering of feature points `(n, d)` (spike features, PCs, positions). |
| [`dspk.synapse.matching`](/dsp-kitchen/plugins/synapse/reference/python/matching/) | Templates and matching. |
| [`dspk.synapse.spatial`](/dsp-kitchen/plugins/synapse/reference/python/spatial/) | Space. |
| [`dspk.synapse.metrics`](/dsp-kitchen/plugins/synapse/reference/python/metrics/) | Unit quality and spike-train analyses. |
